coordinateConvention: u=(east longitude + pi)/(2 pi), v=(pi/2 - planetocentric latitude)/pi; pixel centers; north at top; source longitude registration is not independently verified

coordinates.longitude: east-positive -180..180 (runtime normalization; scientific source alignment unverified)
coordinates.projection: equirectangular texture supplied for NASA 3-D resource
coordinates.sourceCoverage: Voyager 2 mapped southern hemisphere; unmapped regions are retained as source gaps/approximate appearance

sourceAlignment.basis: NASA resource supplies a rendered texture but does not publish a longitude/latitude registration or control-point metadata; JPL's map catalog characterizes maps as representative/aesthetically edited rather than scientific-analysis products; do not infer scientific longitude from pixels.

heightPolicy: No reliable global Umbriel DEM is available. Deterministic restrained relief is generated from a seamless 3D direction-vector field independent of color; it is an appearance approximation, not measured Umbriel topography or image-brightness inference.

provenance.citation: NASA Uranus–Umbriel 3-D resource, mosaicked with Voyager imagery; credit USGS/Tammy Becker and JPL/Caltech
provenance.coverage: Voyager 2 coverage is strongest in the southern hemisphere; unobserved or weakly constrained regions remain explicitly approximate and are not presented as measured mapping.
provenance.license: NASA/JPL/Caltech and USGS public mission imagery; retain attribution.
provenance.processing: Pinned 2048x1024 NASA WebP; resized without reprojection to 512x256, 1024x512 and native 2048x1024 JPEG derivatives; color is never used to derive height.
provenance.proceduralHeight: Seamless direction-vector field, little-endian uint16, height = -120 + sample x 0.5 m; bounded range is recorded per level; synthetic approximation only.

medium.heightEncoding: little-endian uint16; radial height = heightOffsetMeters + sample * heightScaleMeters

near.heightEncoding: little-endian uint16; radial height = heightOffsetMeters + sample * heightScaleMeters
